In the investigations, according to the patient's history and the following graph, he is subjected to temporary immobilization with a long leg splint. The next morning, he complains of pain and swelling of his fingers. The patient's pain increases by moving the fingers. During the examination, the pulse of the dorsalis pedis artery can be felt.
